name: bolta
description: Plan, write and schedule posts in your voice, keep posting every week with Bolta routines, and run campaigns for launches. Nothing goes out until you say yes.

confirm_level.title: Bolta checks
confirm_level.description: standard: drafts save without a check, and a batch of approvals or turning posts down asks once per message. careful: every approval, turning a post down, schedule and delete asks, and so do saving several posts at once, setting up, changing or switching on a Bolta routine, and setting a campaign's accounts or notes. Either way, posting, replying, running a Bolta routine now, starting, resuming or finishing a campaign, changing a running campaign's accounts or notes, voice and business changes, and anything final always ask. Pausing never does. Set in Claude Code; Cowork and chat use standard.
